decision: After the priority rotating-reservoir, thermoelastic-rod and hydrodynamic-heating revisions, using one already prepared and independently validated replacement is justified for this slot. The reviewed options do not establish a concrete next superconducting hardening step worth building now. This is a bounded planning judgment, not a claim that the family cannot be hardened or an authorization to launch or promote a replacement.
evidence_basis: Two of the three actual fresh trials make the correct energy-dependent coherence repair despite indistinguishable calibration. The other retains the edge approximation. All three are scored without infrastructure errors; neither pass relies only on numerical refinement.

Changing temperatures, phases, gap coefficients or calibration density within the existing apparatus leaves the passing physical formula applicable. Such changes could change margins, but do not test a newly identified physical assumption.

The reviewed finite-transparency proposal supplies the complete normal and branch-converting scattering coefficients. Its remaining error is their signed combination as heat. This is a distinct readout mistake, but the repair is a simple positive-energy sum. More elaborate shared scattering algebra does not itself support a harder reasoning task.
driven_junction_boundary: A driven or time-dependent junction would need a separately defined preparation, drive protocol and energy accounting, including what the thermal detector counts and how externally supplied work is separated. Its stationary or finite-time readout and any relaxation assumptions would need specification, a genuinely shared informative calibration, and an independent dynamical reference. Those are apparatus and validation decisions, not harder coefficients in the reviewed static model. No such concrete next step has been defined or assessed here; this report neither proposes nor rejects all driven junctions.
scope_and_limits: The two passes are three-trial evidence, not a statistical proof of easy behavior across every future revision.
The recommendation covers the known incremental changes and the rejected finite-D branch-sign proposal only. There was no open-ended search and no impossibility argument.

A replacement still needs its own valid apparatus, neutral public input, independent science, frozen evaluation plan and honest causal trial review. Its prepared status does not establish qualification.
Prior superconducting sources and all outcomes must remain preserved. Do not resample unchanged sources or reclassify the observed passes.
The three priority family revisions remain ahead of this exception. No particular replacement is selected or certified by this decision.
work_performed: Reread the frozen assessment and verified its two payload hashes. No changes to that review, canonical files, raw jobs or shared status. No numerical, model, Docker, harness or Git operations.
